packageRules.description: Park TypeScript 7. typescript-eslint hard-throws on any TS 7.x (its guard is `versionMajor >= 7`, not a 7.0-only check), and even its canary channel still peers `typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0`. There is no released 7.1 either — only daily 7.1.0-dev nightlies. Unpark when typescript-eslint#10940 lands; it is currently open, unmilestoned and labelled 'blocked by external API'.

Park @babel/plugin-transform-runtime 8. tilde, tend-web and buvik-web pin it at 7.29.7 via `overrides` as a guard. The v8 bump goes green but removes that guard, and the next incremental install then ERESOLVEs (v8 peers @babel/core ^8 while the tree resolves 7 via workbox-build and eslint-plugin-react-hooks). Unpark when those two move to @babel/core 8.

Park ESLint 10 for repos still on 9. eslint-config-next bundles eslint-plugin-react, whose latest (7.37.5) peers at `eslint ^9.7` and errors on ESLint 10 with 'contextOrFilename.getFilename is not a function'. matchCurrentVersion scopes this to repos on 9 only, so repos already running ESLint 10 keep receiving 10.x updates. Unpark when eslint-plugin-react ships ESLint 10 support and Next picks it up.
